landing.painDesc: You might experience these problems every day
landing.pain1Desc: You write all your accounts in one notebook. One day it tears, gets wet, or is lost — years of information vanish in minutes.
landing.pain2Desc: You're tired but spend half an hour adding and subtracting. One small mistake means you see today's profit incorrectly and make a wrong decision.
landing.pain3Desc: A customer takes goods on credit, you record it. A week later, neither you nor they remember. Your money hangs in the air.
landing.pain4Desc: You only see the cash in the register. You don't know how much of the sales was actual profit and where you suffered losses.
landing.pain5Desc: A customer wants an item, but you realize at that moment it's out of stock. The sale is lost, your reputation is tarnished.
landing.pain6Desc: There's no precise record. You don't know who sold what, what amount was received, or what went missing.
landing.pain7Desc: Instead of making more sales, your time is wasted writing, adding up, and searching for information. 2 hours a day, 730 hours a year.
landing.pain7Stat: 2 hours a day · 730 hours a year
landing.pain8Desc: A broken phone, a lost notebook, or a deleted Excel file can destroy your entire business.

legalPage.termsIntro: By using Hisabche, you agree to the terms below. Please read them carefully before using the service.

termsSections.heading: 1. About the service
termsSections.body: Hisabche is an accounting and business-management app offering invoicing, warehouse/inventory management, customer debt tracking, project management, purchasing, manufacturing, and HR tools. Some features work fully offline; others require a connection to our servers.

termsSections.heading: 2. Your account
termsSections.body: You are responsible for keeping your account credentials confidential and for all activity under your account. Contact us immediately if you notice any unauthorized use.

termsSections.heading: 3. Your data
termsSections.body: Business data you enter (invoices, inventory, customers, and similar records) belongs to you. We use it only to provide the service to you and do not sell it to third parties.

termsSections.heading: 4. Acceptable use
termsSections.body: You may not use Hisabche for unlawful activity, to infringe on others' rights, or to attempt unauthorized access to our systems.

termsSections.heading: 5. Availability
termsSections.body: We aim to keep the service available at all times, but brief interruptions may occur for maintenance, updates, or technical issues. The offline app remains usable during these periods.

termsSections.heading: 6. Changes
termsSections.body: We may update these terms from time to time. Material changes will be communicated through the app or by email.

termsSections.heading: 7. Contact
termsSections.body: For questions about these terms, reach us at support@hisabche.com.

legalPage.privacyIntro: Your privacy matters to us. This page explains what information we collect and how we use it.

privacySections.heading: 1. Information we collect
privacySections.body: Account details (name, email, phone), business data you enter yourself (invoices, inventory, customers, transactions), and limited technical data (device type, error logs) used to improve app performance.

privacySections.heading: 2. How we use it
privacySections.body: This information is used solely to provide and improve the Hisabche service, offer customer support, and secure your account. We do not sell your information to advertisers.

privacySections.heading: 3. Storage and security
privacySections.body: Your data is stored on secure cloud infrastructure (Supabase) with encryption. The offline app also stores data locally on your device.

privacySections.heading: 4. Sharing with third parties
privacySections.body: We do not share your information with third parties, except essential infrastructure providers (such as our cloud hosting service) bound by confidentiality obligations.

privacySections.heading: 5. Your rights
privacySections.body: You may request access to, correction of, export of, or full deletion of your account data at any time by contacting support.

privacySections.heading: 6. Cookies
privacySections.body: We use only essential cookies to maintain your login session; no advertising or tracking cookies are used.

faq.start1A: Yes, the free version of Hisabche is completely free for one business and core features. You can purchase the business version for advanced features.
faq.start2Q: How do I start with Hisabche?
faq.start2A: Just click the 'Start Free' button and enter your mobile number. No credit card is needed. After verifying your number, Hisabche is ready immediately.
faq.offline1A: No. Hisabche works completely offline. You can create invoices, update inventory, and add customers even when the internet is down. As soon as you reconnect, everything syncs automatically.
faq.offline2Q: If my phone breaks, will I lose my data?
faq.offline2A: No. All your data is backed up on Hisabche's secure servers. A secure copy is also saved on your phone itself. So you can work with peace of mind.
faq.offline3Q: How many phones can I use it on?
faq.offline3A: With one account, you can log in simultaneously on multiple devices (mobile, tablet, laptop). Synchronization between devices happens automatically.
faq.acc1Q: How do I record credit (customer debt)?
faq.acc1A: When recording a sale, select the 'Credit' option. Hisabche automatically records the customer's debt and sends you a reminder when it's due.
faq.acc2Q: Can I manage my warehouse inventory?
faq.acc2A: Yes. For every product you define, its inventory decreases automatically with each sale. You'll also be alerted before an item runs out.
faq.acc3Q: How can I see my profit and loss?
faq.acc3A: On the Hisabche dashboard, the profit and loss chart is visible in real-time. You can see your daily, weekly, and monthly profits.
faq.sec1A: All data is encrypted in transit and at rest. Daily backups are also taken, and you are the complete owner of your data.
faq.sec2Q: How many users can work simultaneously?
faq.sec2A: Depending on the plan, you can add multiple users with different access levels. Even in the free plan, you can add an additional accountant.
faq.dev1Q: Does it work on older Android phones?
faq.dev1A: Yes. Hisabche is designed to run smoothly on Android 7+ phones with 2GB of RAM. Even on budget devices.
faq.dev2A: Hisabche is web-based and usable on any browser (Windows, Mac, Linux). It also has a dedicated Android app.
faq.dev3A: Yes. You can download all invoices as PDFs and print them on any printer. The invoice template is designed to be simple and elegant.
faq.pay1A: The Free plan for one business with 50 invoices per month is completely free. The Starter plan at $9 per month offers more features. All prices are in Afghani and payable through reputable exchanges.
faq.pay2A: Yes, you can use the Professional version for free for 30 days. No credit card needed.
